verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a SaaS platform that holds sensitive personal data, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data can be excluded from AI model training. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI training opt-out, a data-use policy, or training controls. The secure visa storage claim is about storage, not training use, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
